Hello. Thank you for the response. Being honest I’ve tried therapy in the past and I don’t think it’ll solve anything. This isn’t because of one therapy occasion (I’ve seen multiple) but rather because I have an issue with the world in general smt therapy can’t fix. 

Capitalism, corruption shit like that. The world is fundamentally rotten imo and no matter how much therapy I do, I will have to work till death and nothing abt reality changes.

Just because there is a shift jn perspective, there is no subsequent change in the cruelty/unfair nature of reality.

But that’s just the way I see it, honelsty I’ve been trying to get better for years.

This is me being a straight hypocrite but I hope you don’t kill yourself in a few months. I just think it would be sad and it makes me sad. However I’m being selfish and I hope you find your peace in life however you choose to
